Main Blocker: Requires two mandatory headers: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Harvest-Account-ID: <account_id>
Verification Notes: Verified: Harvest API v2 rejects requests that lack the Harvest-Account-ID header.

Name: Stripe
Description: Global economic infrastructure for internet payments, billing, cards, and treasury.
Auth Methods: API Secret Key (Bearer sk_test_...); Restricted Keys; OAuth2 (Connect)
API Surface: REST (Massive, payments, subscriptions, customers, invoices, checkout, refunds, connect)
Main Blocker: None (Benchmark standard for developer ergonomics; official Stripe Agent Toolkit and MCP exist)
Verification Notes: Verified Stripe official Agent Toolkit and test mode availability.

Name: Plaid
Description: Fintech API connecting consumer bank accounts to apps for account verification, transactions, and balances.
Auth Methods: API Keys (PLAID-CLIENT-ID + PLAID-SECRET in JSON Body or Headers)
API Surface: REST (Broad, auth, transactions, balance, identity, transfer, investments, assets)
Main Blocker: Production bank linking requires client-side Plaid Link SDK token exchange and compliance questionnaire
Verification Notes: Verified Plaid sandbox self-serve environment and community MCP server.

Name: Binance
Description: Global cryptocurrency exchange supporting spot, margin, futures, and algorithmic trading.
Auth Methods: API Key + HMAC-SHA256 Signature Header; RSA / ED25519 Keypair
API Surface: REST & WebSocket (Massive, market data, order execution, account status, streaming tickers)
Main Blocker: Requires cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated over timestamp and query parameters on private endpoints
Verification Notes: Verified: Binance private endpoints reject unsigned requests; testnet provides instant keys.

Name: Paygent Connect
Description: Japanese payment gateway service (joint venture of DeNA and Mitsubishi UFJ NICOS) / NMI-powered payment router.
Auth Methods: Merchant ID + Hash Key / Client Certificate (mTLS)
API Surface: REST / CGI Form-urlencoded (Payment processing, recurring billing, 3D Secure)
Main Blocker: Corporate sales contract, Japanese business entity registration, and IP whitelisting required to access gateway endpoints
Verification Notes: Audited: Paygent is a strictly enterprise Japanese merchant acquirer requiring formal underwriting.

Name: iPayX
Description: AI-powered B2B automated billing, payments, and receivables clearinghouse platform.
API Surface: REST (Invoicing, payments, settlement reconciliations)
Main Blocker: Requires commercial onboarding and compliance clearance for merchant underwriting
Verification Notes: Verified: iPayX requires merchant underwriting; documentation confirms partner-gated credentials.

Name: QuickBooks
Description: Small business accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, and invoicing software by Intuit.
Auth Methods: OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code Grant with Refresh Token)
API Surface: REST (Broad, invoices, payments, customers, vendors, accounts, reports)
Main Blocker: Requires realmId (companyId) in endpoint URI; strict OAuth2 refresh token expiration cycles (101 days / 24 hr access)
Verification Notes: Verified Intuit Developer sandbox provides free, self-serve access to QuickBooks Online API.

Name: Xero
Description: Cloud-based accounting software for small businesses, accountants, and bookkeepers.
Auth Methods: OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code with PKCE / Client Credentials)
API Surface: REST (Broad, invoices, bank transactions, contacts, bills, payroll, assets)
Main Blocker: Requires xero-tenant-id header passed in every API call alongside Bearer token
Verification Notes: Verified Xero requires both Bearer token and xero-tenant-id header from connection endpoint.

Name: Brex
Description: Corporate credit cards, spend management, travel, and business banking platform for startups.
API Surface: REST (Broad, expenses, corporate cards, transfers, budgets, transactions, webhooks)
Main Blocker: Requires an active Brex corporate account (which requires US incorporated business entity and funding thresholds)
Verification Notes: Verified: While API token generation is self-serve in dashboard, acquiring a Brex account requires company vetting.

Name: Ramp
Description: Corporate cards, expense management, vendor bill pay, and automated accounting platform.
API Surface: REST (Broad, cards, transactions, receipts, reimbursements, departments, spend programs)
Main Blocker: Requires active Ramp business entity account; multi-tenant apps require Developer Partner approval
Verification Notes: Verified: Ramp uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials and requires an active corporate account.

Name: PitchBook
Description: Financial market research database delivering private market capital, VC, PE, and M&A data.
API Surface: REST (Companies, funding rounds, investors, valuations, deals, executives)
Main Blocker: Extreme financial sales paywall ($25k+/yr institutional contract) and mandatory data licensing agreements
Verification Notes: Verified: PitchBook API is exclusively enterprise contact-sales with stringent compliance vetting.

Name: NotebookLM
Description: Google's personalized AI research assistant grounded in user-curated notes, PDFs, and sources.
Auth Methods: OAuth2 (Google Cloud Vertex AI / Enterprise API) / Session Cookie (Consumer)
API Surface: Enterprise API / Vertex AI Extensions (No public standalone consumer REST API)
Main Blocker: Consumer version lacks an official public open REST API; agents must use Google Cloud enterprise connectors or browser automation
Verification Notes: Verified: NotebookLM consumer app has no public REST API. Enterprise features reside within Google Cloud.

Name: Otter AI
Description: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, summarizes, and extracts action items from conversations.
Auth Methods: Session Bearer / Unofficial Cookie / Enterprise Webhook
API Surface: Unofficial REST / Enterprise Webhooks (No open documented public REST API)
MCP Status: Community MCP Available (Unofficial session token wrapper)
Main Blocker: Lack of an official, documented public developer REST API; existing MCP servers rely on reverse-engineered user session cookies
Verification Notes: Investigation revealed Otter.ai has no official developer portal; community MCP uses reverse-engineered cookies.

Name: Fathom
Description: AI meeting recorder and note taker for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.
API Surface: REST (Moderate, meetings, transcripts, summaries, action items, webhooks)
Main Blocker: Requires Fathom Team Edition or paid subscription to unlock developer API keys
Verification Notes: Verified: Free individual tier lacks API key provisioning; Team Edition subscription required.

Name: Consensus
Description: AI-powered academic search engine delivering evidence-based answers synthesized from 200M+ research papers.
API Surface: REST (Search, academic claims synthesis, paper metadata, citations)
Main Blocker: API is in private beta requiring sales approval; OAuth2 requested by community but not yet public self-serve
Verification Notes: Verified: 'OAuth requested' is a feature request in their community; API remains gated behind private enterprise beta.

Name: Reducto
Description: API-first document parsing engine that turns complex PDFs, tables, and figures into clean vision-augmented markdown.
API Surface: REST (High Utility, /parse, /extract, /async, /job status, webhooks)
Main Blocker: None (Designed natively for LLM pipeline integration with direct Bearer token auth)
Verification Notes: Verified Reducto API docs, instant trial credits, and community MCP server.

Name: Devin
Description: Autonomous AI software engineer by Cognition AI that plans, writes, tests, and deploys complex code.
API Surface: REST & Official MCP (Create sessions, send messages, inspect execution logs, retrieve snapshots)
Main Blocker: Requires paid Devin account subscription ($500/mo minimum tier for API access)
Verification Notes: Corrected: Cognition launched official docs.devin.ai, self-serve developer API, and official MCP server.

Name: higgsfield
Description: Generative video and creative AI platform for cinematic character animation and camera control.
API Surface: CLI & REST (Video generation, camera prompts, job queue polling)
Main Blocker: Requires paid generation compute credits; long-polling asynchronous job execution required for video rendering
Verification Notes: Verified: Video generation compute requires paid credits; CLI tool provides token login.

Name: Mermaid CLI
Description: Open-source command-line interface for converting Mermaid diagram definitions into PNG, SVG, and PDF images.
Auth Methods: CLI Execution / Local Process (No API Key needed)
API Surface: CLI / Library (Command line flags: -i input.mmd -o output.svg; no SaaS HTTP endpoint)
Main Blocker: Not a SaaS REST API; agent toolkit must invoke local Node.js / Puppeteer process to render diagrams
Verification Notes: Identified that Mermaid CLI is an npm CLI wrapper over Puppeteer; agents run it locally or inside Docker.

Name: YouTube Transcript
Description: Specialized developer API service for fetching transcripts, captions, and timed text from any public YouTube video.
API Surface: REST (Focused/High Utility: /transcript, /subtitles, /languages, /metadata)
Main Blocker: None (Direct HTTP GET requests with video ID parameter and API key header)
Verification Notes: Verified transcriptapi.com documentation and community MCP wrappers for YouTube caption fetching.

Name: Grain
Description: AI meeting recorder, clip creator, and conversation intelligence platform for sales and customer success teams.
API Surface: REST (Moderate, recordings, highlights, transcripts, summaries, webhooks)
Main Blocker: API keys are restricted to paid Business plan workspaces
Verification Notes: Verified: Grain developer API keys are locked to paid Business workspaces.
